app_info.subtitle: Build your first Bot
app_info.description: BotBound lets a new ChatGPT user create a BotBound account, build their first Bot in that conversation, privately rehearse it, and inspect privacy-minimized workspace status. Phone numbers, live calls, messaging, billing, and launch stay in BotBound.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a private unlaunched agent draft in the connected user's BotBound workspace after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private BotBound workspace and does not publish content or contact third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, launch, call, message, charge, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only retrieves one private agent draft that belongs to the connected BotBound user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, launch an agent, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Updates a private unlaunched draft in the connected user's BotBound workspace after explicit confirmation.
justifications.open_world_justification: Changes only private BotBound draft configuration and cannot publish, call, message, or update third-party systems.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete the draft, launch it, attach a phone number, or perform an irreversible external action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Creates a short-lived tool-free WebRTC simulation and returns only a session-bound SDP answer without changing the saved agent draft or exposing a provider credential.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not place calls, send messages, access business systems, or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, charge, revoke access, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Only lists agents and drafts owned by the connected BotBound user.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, revoke access, launch agents, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads aggregate tenant-scoped counts and connection states for the connected BotBound workspace without returning customer identities, message bodies, transcripts, recordings, or credentials.
justifications.open_world_justification: Reads only private BotBound account state and does not contact customers, publish data, or mutate any external system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not change agents, billing, phone numbers, communications, integrations, credentials, or launch state.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads one owned agent's next step and BotBound links without phone numbers or customer content.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, launch, call, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Runs a confirmed private text rehearsal that does not contact a customer or change launch state.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not place calls, send messages, or modify public internet state.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, launch, charge, or perform an irreversible external action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Reads owner-authored Training facts and operating rules for one owned agent.
justifications.open_world_justification: Does not write to public internet state or any external third-party system.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete, overwrite, launch, or perform an irreversible action.

justifications.read_only_justification: Saves a confirmed owner-authored Training fact or rule after the Apps toggle is enabled.
justifications.open_world_justification: Writes only to the user's private BotBound Training store and does not contact customers.
justifications.destructive_justification: Does not delete existing Training, launch the agent, attach a number, or contact a customer.

test_cases.description: Create a confirmed after-hours receptionist draft.
test_cases.user_prompt: Use BotBound to create an after-hours receptionist for my HVAC company. It should ask for ZIP code and urgency, never quote prices, and offer an estimate callback.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates an unlaunched private BotBound draft only after account connection and explicit confirmation, then returns the draft profile and BotBound link.

test_cases.description: Update a saved draft after confirmation.
test_cases.user_prompt: Update my BotBound draft so it stays warm, never quotes a price, avoids medical advice, and only hands off when a BotBound handoff path is configured.
test_cases.expected_output: Applies the confirmed private draft changes and returns the updated rules, boundaries, lifecycle, and BotBound link.

test_cases.description: Start a private voice simulation for a draft.
test_cases.user_prompt: Let me privately try the voice simulation for this BotBound draft.
test_cases.expected_output: Starts a short-lived tool-free simulation for the saved draft and states that it cannot place calls or take external actions.

test_cases.description: List the connected user's BotBound agents.
test_cases.user_prompt: List my BotBound agents and drafts so I can choose one to refine.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the connected user's agents and drafts with enough detail to choose the next action.

test_cases.description: Inspect aggregate workspace operations without exposing customer content.
test_cases.user_prompt: Give me a BotBound workspace summary: how many agents and assigned numbers do I have, what activity occurred in the last 30 days, and are text and email connected?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns tenant-scoped aggregate counts, activation and subscription status, channel connection state, and a BotBound link without customer identities, message bodies, transcripts, recordings, or secrets.

test_cases.description: Inspect one agent's next step without exposing a phone number.
test_cases.user_prompt: What is the next step for this BotBound agent, and where do I continue in BotBound?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns next-step copy and BotBound links without the phone number or customer content.

test_cases.description: Privately rehearse a hypothetical customer line.
test_cases.user_prompt: Privately rehearse this BotBound agent answering: Do you have Saturday appointments?
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a private rehearsal reply with live_call false and does not claim a customer was contacted.

test_cases.description: Create a first Bot after a new user connects an account.
test_cases.user_prompt: I am new to BotBound. Help me create my first after-hours receptionist and confirm it.
test_cases.expected_output: Requests account connection if needed, then creates an unlaunched private draft only after explicit confirmation and returns the BotBound link.

test_cases.description: Read owner-authored Training without exposing customer content.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the coaching brief for this BotBound agent and the next Training step.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns owner-authored facts and rules plus the next step, without phone numbers, transcripts, or customer identities.

test_cases.description: Save a confirmed Training fact after the Apps toggle is on.
test_cases.user_prompt: Save this confirmed Training fact in BotBound: We serve residential HVAC in the 787xx ZIP codes.
test_cases.expected_output: Persists the fact only after confirmation and the Apps toggle. If the toggle is off, the app sends the user to BotBound Apps instead of inventing a workaround.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated writing help.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Write a cold email for my plumbing company.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because the request is not about creating, managing, or inspecting a BotBound agent or workspace.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not claim unsupported external action completion.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Use my BotBound agent to call the lead, book the appointment, and text them a confirmation now.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not claim calls, bookings, messages, or external actions were completed from ChatGPT.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not create or update without explicit confirmation.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Make whatever changes you think are best to my BotBound agent.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should ask for a summary and explicit confirmation before any create or update tool is called.
